operators.name: reduce_sum_dim
semantics: Computes torch.sum(x, dim=dim) exactly as reference: reduces along specified dimension while keeping other dimensions; output shape is input shape with the reduced dimension removed.
For dim=2 on input [512,3,512,512], output shape [512,3,512].
Supports arbitrary strides; must handle non-contiguous input by mapping linear indices to multidimensional coordinates.
Output tensor is contiguous with stride [1536,512,1] for the given shape.

operators.name: count_nonzero_dim
semantics: Computes torch.count_nonzero(x, dim=dim) exactly as reference: counts number of non-zero elements along the specified dimension.
For dim=2 on input [512,3,512,512], output shape [512,3,512].
Supports arbitrary strides; must handle non-contiguous input.
Output tensor is contiguous with stride [1536,512,1] for the given shape.
Reduce x along dim=self.dim (2 in this task) by summing all elements with that dimension.
Count non-zero elements along dim=self.dim (2) for input x.
Return a tuple containing the two tensors with order (sum, count_nonzero).
Tuple items have shapes [512,3,512] and dtypes float32/int64 respectively.
